record.name: Togo
record.summary: No qualifying institute or commitment identified. Togo AI Lab supports public policy with applied data science, while official sources confirm national AI-strategy work; neither source assigns evaluation of the safety of advanced models.

next_check.reason: Routine re-check on a two-year rotation of states with no reported plans.

partial.scope: Negative-status confidence, preserved query provenance, national/official-language search coverage and source-independence audit; this is not a full recheck of all record fields.
Reassessed negative confidence under the revised rule using saved research. No retained English query. No new search or full recheck.
Checked source quotations against retained source material and documented extraction limitations; this was a partial excerpt-evidence audit, not a new search or a full recheck of the jurisdiction.
Attempted preservation of cited source copies and checked saved-copy hashes; failures remain in source access notes. This source-evidence work is not a full factual recheck of the record.

English searches for a national AI safety, security or evaluation institute, commitment, proposal or study. No qualifying institute was identified. The government source describes consultations to formulate a national AI strategy, without a designation or commitment to evaluation of the safety of advanced models. Partial check only; the last full-check date is unchanged.

Aligned current rationale wording with the consolidated capability-or-behaviour-risk test, removing the old severity requirement. This editorial consistency pass adds no research claim and does not change status or the last full-check date.

check.language_note: The recorded fr query uses a national or official language selected for this country-specific check. Other national or official languages were not exhaustively searched. Search source_ids identify registered source URLs matched in the retrieved result set, which may include irrelevant hits. An empty list means no registered source URL was matched, not that the web response was empty. The earlier audit used independent_source_ids for substantive corroboration; governance_source_ids, where present, identifies the selected primary governance evidence. English queries were also run on 17 October 2026; the previously recorded national or official-language coverage and its limits are unchanged.
check.independence_note: Historical audit under the superseded two-independent-sources rule: CEGA is a founding partner of Togo AI Lab. Its account and the government account do not provide independent corroboration of that institutional activity. Confidence was low under that rule; none_identified is a bounded search finding, not proof of absence.
check.governance_note: The government describes national AI-strategy work; the separate ministry-led Togo AI Lab supports public-policy applications rather than evaluation of the safety of advanced models.

related_bodies.name: Ministry of Public Service Efficiency and Digital Transformation
related_bodies.role: It leads digital transformation and AI-strategy work; no qualifying model-evaluation institute was identified.

related_bodies.name: Togo AI Lab
related_bodies.role: It applies data science to public policies, including health, agriculture and education, through a government and UC Berkeley CEGA partnership. No national designation to evaluate the safety of advanced models was identified.

record.notes: The re-check read the official 4 October 2024 call to develop the national AI strategy, the 24 July 2025 ministerial interview at CEGA, and the current CEGA Togo AI Lab institutional page. These confirm the lab and strategy work, resolving the baseline primary-source gap. The lab uses applied models for policy and service delivery; the minister distinguishes impact evaluation of programmes, and no mandate to evaluate advanced models for capabilities or behaviour risks is found. The official lab homepage https://datalab.gouv.tg/ was JS-only and one attempt to retrieve a text copy failed; the ministry homepage was framework-only and one attempt to retrieve a text copy failed. CEGA, a founding partner, supplied the readable primary institutional evidence. No national strategy adoption date is asserted. French, the official language, and English were searched; Ewe and Kabiyè were not comprehensively checked.
